text:
Samir (support): VelumPay reporting repeated 429s across several services since 09:12 UTC. They say spikes every ~30s, affects checkout path. They attached a short request log.
Marta (eng-sre): Can you paste the request headers we returned? Need x-rate-limit-* and any retry-after.
Raj (oncall): Pulling logs now. From edge proxy for customer=velumpay: `x-rate-limit-limit: 1200`, `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `x-rate-limit-reset: 24` on many requests. No `retry-after` present in some, present in others.`
Samir (support): Customer snippet shows a tight client loop with immediate retries on 429, and the SDK is creating 10 parallel workers per account. They weren't using exponential jitter.
Jane L (customer-success): VelumPay says they rolled out a new sync worker pool last night, 500 instances, hit prod at 09:11. They expected smoothing but said their backoff is basic fixed-interval retry.
Marta (eng-sre): Hypothesis: synchronized cron/worker start + no jitter -> minute-boundary clustering -> burst of requests that exhaust RPM. That explains repeating bursts ~30s as different AZs round-robin.
Raj (oncall): Repro from logs: request rate by minute for velumpay: 1100, 3200, 1150, 3050 in alternating minutes. TPM high but remaining goes to 0 on high minute. So both RPM and TPM effects.
Samir (support): Customer asks immediate mitigations. Suggested: 1) Client-side: add exponential backoff + full jitter, cap concurrency to 4 per account, introduce random start jitter. 2) Server-side: temporary quota bump? 3) Long-term: recommend Dedicated or smoothing proxy.
Marta (eng-sre): Also suggest they enable streaming for batch uploads if possible, or batch events server-side to reduce token count. For short term we can whitelist a controlled quota increase for 24-48h while they throttle.
Raj (oncall): I can apply a +50% RPM quota for velumpay for 6 hours, need approval from support lead. That will reduce immediate 429s while CS coordinates client changes.
Jane L (customer-success): I'll ask VelumPay to ship a 0-30s randomized startup jitter and reduce worker concurrency. I'll get them to add exponential jitter on retry (retry base 250ms, multiplier 2, cap 10s, jitter 0.5x).
Samir (support): Quick repro steps for eng: simulate N workers hitting same minute boundary -> run script: ````
for i in {1..500}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "http_code:%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" $API_URL &
done
wait
````
Marta (eng-sre): I'll run a controlled replay against staging with rate limiting identical to prod and validate how x-rate-limit headers behave, and ensure proxy sets `Retry-After` consistently.
Raj (oncall): I also opened incident ticket INC-5429 and annotated tags: velumpay, ratecap, rpm-tpm, burst. Added link to logs: https://logs.redwood.example/velumpay/4134567890
Samir (support): Customer update: they accepted client changes and asked for the 6h bump while they roll. CS will confirm once jitter is deployed.
Marta (eng-sre): After client fixes, follow-up: recommend moving heavy sync to dedicated off-peak windows and consider Redwood Dedicated if sustained throughput > 3k RPM. Also add circuit-breaker on client side to stop retry storms.
Jane L (customer-success): I'll coordinate and close after validation. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Samir (support): Closing temporary work items: - Raj to apply quota bump (in progress) - Marta to run replay and confirm Retry-After - Jane to collect deployment timestamp from VelumPay and report back - Samir to update playbook with sample client jitter snippet.
deploy-bot: rollout/velumpay-quota-bump started by Raj at 09:43 UTC - change id cb-8271
Samir (support): Noted. Will follow up in 12h to ensure no residual 429s.
